The primary-source search licenses a phenomenological projector instrument but not circuit-level fault tolerance.

scientific_model.physical_system: the paper L=2 periodic colored-honeycomb D4 interface already validated in Labs 004-005
scientific_model.hidden_state: the true projector outcome and post-measurement state/update digest remain private sidecar data
scientific_model.public_observation: round-indexed reported anyon labels or binary restricted D4 records, plus declared action digests; no physical error, true label, future record, seed, or logical outcome
scientific_model.projector_semantics: a true outcome is selected from mutually exclusive complete local anyon projectors; the hidden state update follows the selected projector before classical reporting noise
scientific_model.readout_semantics: false negative removes a true reported species and false positive adds an absent reported species; direct label confusion is represented only when decomposable into those source-declared events, not borrowed from G by default
scientific_model.quasi_stabilizer_semantics: the five-star false-negative trajectory is a separate source reproduction fixture because its intermediate-anyon fluctuation is not equivalent to independent classical corruption of commuting-projector labels
scientific_model.action_semantics: post-flux charge observations become available only after the bound flux-action digest, preserving the E0 two-call order
scientific_model.resolution_limit: the study can verify a projector-level phenomenological instrument and interface invariants, not ancilla faults, hardware correlations, thresholds, or schedule advantage

analysis_and_stop_rules.comparison_rule: Evaluate E1A, E1B, and E1C independently; one passing cell cannot hide another cell's semantic failure.
analysis_and_stop_rules.success: All cells satisfy their own acceptance items and the perfect limit reproduces E0 in both public modes.
analysis_and_stop_rules.localized_negative: Preserve any passing projector/report layer while marking the failed quasi-stabilizer or API-translation layer unresolved.
analysis_and_stop_rules.stop: Do not add ad hoc hardware noise, decoder performance, larger lattices, or extra rounds when a source/interface gate fails.
analysis_and_stop_rules.escalation: Ask the researcher only if resolving a localized failure requires selecting a hardware extraction circuit, a new correlated readout model, or a larger dependency/compute budget.
